Educational projection only. Real returns depend on premium at purchase, spread at sale, storage cost, and actual price movement — none of which are guaranteed.
What this tells you (and doesn't)
The calculator projects forward at a chosen annual growth rate — it's a
scenario tool
, not a forecast. Real outcomes depend on the price you
actually paid (premium varies), the spread when you sell (dealers buy below
spot), storage / insurance cost over the hold period, and whether the metal
held its assumed growth rate over your specific window.
For a directional check, the long-term annualized return for gold has been
~8% in USD nominal terms
since 2000 (LBMA / World Gold Council).
Silver is more volatile; long-term ~6.5%. Platinum/palladium are heavily
industrial and harder to baseline — use those with caution.
